The password reset email template constructs the reset link using `process.env.PUBLIC_URL` defaulting to `http://localhost:3000` instead of reading from the application configuration (`config`), causing production emails to contain localhost links.

Proposed change in src/notifications/templates.ts: update BASE_URL to read from the application configuration (`config`) instead of process.env.PUBLIC_URL so that password reset email links point to the correct production domain.
